 2 | Text Analysis I | caster | 1 min/lvl (C) | self | U
 3 | Stone Analysis | caster | - | 10' | I
 4 | Metal Analysis | caster | - | 10' | I
 5 | Gas Analysis | caster | - | 10' | I
 7 | Text Analysis II | caster | 1 min/lvl (C) | self | U
 8 | Liquid Analysis | caster | - | 10' | I
10 | Delving | 1 item | - | touch | I
11 | Spell Analysis | 1 spell | - | 100' | I
14 | Death Analysis | 1 corpse | - | touch | I
15 | Text Analysis III | caster | 1 min/lvl (C) | self | U
16 | Power Analysis | 1 target | - | 100' | P
17 | Conveyance | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
18 | Death’s Delving | 1 corpse | - | touch | I
20 | Analysis | 1 target | - | 10' | I

50 | Conveyance True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 2
Caster can read text written in an unknown language, but only understand basic
concepts of it. This spell gives the caster the equivalent of rank 2 knowledge
in a written language.
@@ 3
Gives nature and origin of natural stone, and when and how worked stone was
obtained and worked.
@@ 4
As Stone Analysis, except metal may be examined.
@@ 5
As Stone Analysis, except gas may be examined.
@@ 7
As Text Analysis I, except gives a complete technical analysis (vocabulary and
syntax) but not an understanding of idioms (jargon), implications, or cultural
references. This spell gives the caster the equivalent of rank 5 knowledge in
a written language.
@@ 8
As Stone Analysis, except liquid may be examined.
@@ 10
Gives significant details about an item’s construction and purpose (not
specific powers).
@@ 11
Provides analysis of an active spell; giving its duration, the list it was
cast from, and its type (not its level or exactly what spell it is).
@@ 14
Gives information concerning a being’s death (weapon, spell, time since,
etc.); must be cast in place of death (within 24 hour) or in the presence of
body (no time limit).
@@ 15
As Text Analysis II, except everything but implications is known (e.g.,
answers to riddles are not known automatically). This spell gives the caster
the equivalent of rank 8 knowledge in a written language.
@@ 16
As Spell Analysis, except will work on abilities/powers that are not currently
active. One item, person, or place may be examined to see if it has power,
which realm the power is from, a general idea of its origin, and its basic
configuration.
@@ 17
Caster’s awareness leaves his body (which is inactive for the duration of the
spell) and may travel at 1 mile per minute. However, it can only travel 10'
per round when moving through solid material or when observing the world. If
the spell expires before the caster returns to his body, he will return to his
body at the fixed rate of 500' per round, and upon returning to his body, he
must make a RR modified by -50 or die (the attack level is equal to the number
of rounds overstayed).
@@ 18
As Death Analysis, except gives a visual image of the killer, and a vague
reason for death (e.g., revenge, robbery, accident, etc.).
@@ 20
Any of the lower level spells may be used together on one item, person, or
place (Conveyance is not included).
@@ 25
As Analysis, except one item per round may be examined.
@@ 30
As Power Analysis, except exact origin, creator, and detailed purpose are
given; this includes exact spell (when appropriate).
@@ 50
As Conveyance, except rate is 10 mile per minute (50' per round through solid
material and while observing).
